title: Helicopter PHIBLEX from USS Princeton

paragraphs.text: CONDUCTED PHIBLEX The Battalion conducted a PHIBLEX which was a move- ment by helicopter from the USS PRINCETON to Marine Corps Base, Camp Pendleton, California. Three (3) rifle companies and elements of H&S Co. participated, however, companies were at approximately 40% manning level.
